title: Drips, Blocks, and Aid: Rewiring Global Humanitarian Action for the Next Generation
description: For decades, international development has relied on slow, legacy financial rails and siloed software. But today's crises—from climate disasters to systemic displacement—don't wait for legacy systems to catch up. In this lightning talk, Katalin Illés explores how the UNICEF Office of Innovation is moving past the hype of frontier tech to build an architecture of equity. Discover how UNICEF leverages Web3 protocols, crypto-denominated investments, and Digital Public Goods (DPGs) to shift the center of gravity in global aid—putting capital, trust, and digital sovereignty directly into the hands of local builders in emerging markets.
